notes: Stop simulating now actually stops: it used to leave the session open, so your iPhone stayed where you had put it. Changing your location while away from your computer works again. Unplugging the cable no longer leaves you stuck. An expired pairing now renews itself whenever your iPhone is plugged in. Anywhere is a third connection option beside USB and Wi-Fi, so you can choose Tailscale on purpose, and stopping while you are away warns you first. Wi-Fi is no longer labelled experimental.
